content.tagline: Two Korean skincare brands, one confirmed 140-item catalogue.
content.descriptor: Two Tigers Corp (Korea): Wati for Skin micro-spicule and PDRN skincare, and Dr.Papirub PDRN-exosome care.
about: Two Tigers Corp is a Korean company behind two skincare brands, Wati for Skin and Dr.Papirub. Teranova's team met the company's sales staff at K-Beauty Expo 2026 and received the brands' official product deck directly from Two Tigers Corp.

The Wati for Skin range is built around micro-spicule and PDRN-exosome delivery formats: essences, creams, ampoules and masks across more than two dozen product families, from the signature Micro Spicule 100 essence line to eye care, lip care, hair and body care. Dr.Papirub adds a compact PDRN skincare range and one fragrance. Every product name, volume and property on this page comes from the brands' own catalogue; where the company did not state a property, it is left out rather than guessed.
